title: Lines, Angles and Congruence Proofs
summary: Angle theorems, congruence rules (SSS, SAS, ASA, RHS) and writing two-column proofs.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Manjari (2026) Part 2: Propositions and their Converses (proof and converses; congruence tests are used, not taught)
Earlier NCERT: Lines and Angles; Triangles

objectives: I can prove angle facts about intersecting and parallel lines.
I can use congruence rules to prove triangles congruent.
I can write a proof with a reason for every step.
misconceptions: A diagram that looks right is a proof.
